business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Travel technology platform: airline IT, retailing, and global distribution for airlines, agencies and travel suppliers

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Cloud-native, modular software platform (Sabre Mosaic) plus travel marketplace and distribution services

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Per booking or segment distribution fees from suppliers; airline IT solutions charged per passenger boarded or by usage

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Multi-year agreements with airlines and travel companies

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat usage-based booking and transaction fees plus long-term airline IT contracts

implementation_transition_work.label: Implementation / transition work
implementation_transition_work.value: Migration and platform modernization for airlines and agencies, such as PSS upgrades and moves to Sabre

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Cloud-native, modular platform with APIs, hosted by Sabre

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Travel: airline passenger service, retailing and offer/order, shopping, distribution, payments, and agency tools

processing_transaction_platform_7374.label: Processing / transaction platform [7374]
processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Travel shopping, booking and distribution transaction processing, with payments and virtual cards

notes: Contract terms, retention and revenue mix are not in the evidence; the charging unit and distribution model come from general knowledge of Sabre.
